pattern.description: Shared 49-byte pre-carve TCP payload for READ, SELECT, OPERATE responses; RID-driven carve to [28,21] via the proven RRC mechanism.
pattern.carve_mechanism: defense4_rrc_kernel.p4 RID1/RID2 (9ffa9102, RRC_49_CUT28, fixed cut, no runtime parameter)

SELECT.transform_required: request-side qualifier rewrite: native G12V1 object qualifier 0x28 -> 0x17, count 1 -> 2, in place

OPERATE.status: expected_by_structural_symmetry; physical OPERATE never run through RRC at any cardinality; UNMEASURED

not_selected_but_worth_pursuing_in_paral.description: Converge on native 37-byte response (no switch transform) if an operator-acceptable 13-point READ poll is available.
not_selected_but_worth_pursuing_in_paral.blocking_reason: depends on production master poll configuration outside this task's authorization/access

open_gates_before_phase_d_can_call_this_: qualifier-rewrite codec built and validated against the OpenDNP3 endpoint_gate semantic harness
OPERATE exercised through the RRC path on the local model (not assumed from SELECT symmetry)
combined pipe-0 egress compile against installed_nf_05 (only 2/64 32-bit PHV containers free)
request-direction size residual (20B READ vs 45B SELECT/OPERATE) stated explicitly in any indistinguishability claim
arrival-order reversal ([21,28] recorded vs [28,21] TCP sequence) remains open, unaffected by this pattern choice
